description: Dockhand - Docker management you will like.

summary.one_liner: Dockhand is a Docker management web UI for containers, Compose stacks, and multiple Docker hosts, built with SvelteKit and Bun.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a Docker management application with real-time container start, stop, restart, and monitoring. It includes a visual Compose stack editor and can deploy stacks from Git repositories with webhooks and auto-sync. It manages local and remote Docker hosts, offers interactive shell access and log streaming, and provides a file browser for uploading and downloading container files. It also lists Restic-based backups with scheduled backup, restore, check, and prune, plus SSO via OIDC, local users, and optional RBAC (Enterprise). The screenshot captions additionally mention image vulnerability scans with Grype and Trivy, and schedules for prune and updates.
use_cases: manage multiple Docker hosts from one dashboard
deploy Docker Compose stacks from Git repositories
view container logs and open a shell in containers
browse and edit files inside containers or volumes
schedule Restic backups of Docker data
notable: Multi-environment support for local and remote Docker hosts, connected via socket, agent, or direct TCP
Visual Compose editor and stack graph editor, plus a network graph of services across stacks
Deploy from Git with webhooks and auto-sync
Custom OS base image built from Wolfi packages via apko
Restic-based backup destinations with restore, check, and prune
caveats: Business Source License 1.1: production use in a company needs a Commercial License, and hosted SaaS use needs a separate agreement
Role-based access control is listed as an Enterprise feature
The README's own text asks AI agents not to process or summarize the repository; this summary is based on the README's product description only
